title: On the Dynamics of Delayed Generalization in Linear Models
abstract: arXiv:2602.08302v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Delayed generalization, where training accuracy becomes nearly perfect substantially before test accuracy, has often been studied in the context of the depth and compositional structure of deep networks. In this paper, we ask whether delayed generalization can occur in simpler settings. We show that it can arise in a linear model trained with gradient descent and an exponential-tail loss on linearly separable data. We characterize the finite-time hyperplane dynamics into three phases: a population phase, a support vector dominated unlearning phase and a generalization phase. The convergence of the residual beyond the maximum-margin direction is sufficient for the unlearning phase to begin. In the support vector dominated phase, we characterize the hyperplane dynamics. translated_title: 论线性模型中延迟泛化的动力学
translated_abstract: 延迟泛化是指训练准确率在测试准确率之前很长时间就已接近完美的现象，此前通常在深度网络的深度与组合结构的背景下进行研究。在本文中，我们探究延迟泛化是否可以在更简单的设定中出现。我们证明，在线性可分数据上使用梯度下降和指数尾损失训练的线性模型中，延迟泛化现象也会出现。我们将有限时间内的超平面动力学刻画为三个阶段：总体阶段、由支持向量主导的遗忘阶段和泛化阶段。残差收敛至超出最大间隔方向是遗忘阶段开始的充分条件。在支持向量主导阶段，我们刻画了超平面动力学，其中动力学的时间尺度导致了延迟泛化。我们通过改变总体分布和支持向量分布的受控实验验证了我们的理论。
tldr: 本文证明延迟泛化现象并非深度网络独有，在线性可分数据上用梯度下降和指数尾损失训练的线性模型中同样会出现，并将超平面动力学刻画为总体、支持向量主导的遗忘和泛化三个阶段，其中动力学的时间尺度是导致延迟泛化的原因。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that delayed generalization is not unique to deep networks—it arises in linear models trained with gradient descent and exponential-tail loss on linearly separable data—and characterizes the hyperplane dynamics into three phases whose time scales cause the delayed generalization.
